title: Iron Back
intro: Your back stays still and stiff while your hips push hard and one arm carries a load. Nothing bends or twists your spine under load.

Leave 48 hours between sessions, and not the day before a match. The Take the Edge Off block is fine on its own before you play. Do two holds at an RPE of 6 instead of four. Set the dumbbell on a table or counter at about hip height, pick it up from there and put it back the same way, never off the floor. Turn at the end of the carry by stepping your feet around, not by twisting. No room to walk fifteen metres? Hold the carry in place for thirty seconds. You also need a bench or firm sofa against a wall, and a broom handle. If it's no better after about six weeks, see a physio, or sooner if it's getting worse or coming on earlier than it used to.

before.label: Who it's for
before.text: A back that's fine lying down and complains when you serve, when you reach low for a volley, or two hours into a match, and that a doctor or physio has already looked at and cleared you to train. If your back hurts most of the time, or you've never done anything for it before, start with Steady Spine for a few weeks.

before.label: Stop and get it looked at
before.text: Pain running down a leg, numbness, weakness in a leg or foot, or numbness between your legs. Also if your back pain started after a fall or a hit, or if it wakes you at night. If your bladder or bowel control changes, get seen the same day.

before.label: While you train
before.text: A bit of ache is fine. Sharp pain isn't, and neither is pain that builds through a set or feels worse the next morning. If it builds, stop that exercise. If it's sharp, stop the session.

exercises.name: Suitcase Carry
exercises.note: On a flared-up day, do just this block at an RPE of 6 and don't mark the session done.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Split Squat
exercises.note: If your back feels worse the next morning than before you started, drop one set from each exercise in this block next time, and if it's still worse after that, get it looked at.
